description: This file provides functions to load Supabase configuration settings from environment variables and to create a Supabase client for server-side use in the application. It defines a data class for settings and exposes interface functions for external modules.

classes.name: SupabaseSettings
classes.description: Immutable data class holding the runtime settings required for Supabase access, specifically the URL and service role key.

methods.name: SupabaseSettings get_supabase_settings()
methods.description: Loads and returns the Supabase configuration from environment variables, raising an error if required variables are missing.

methods.name: Client get_supabase_admin_client()
methods.description: Creates and returns a Supabase Client instance using the loaded settings, intended for server-side administrative operations.
